definitions.explanation: Acting or speaking without careful consideration of the consequences.

examples.japanese: {軽率|けいそつ}な{発言|はつげん}で{問題|もんだい}になった。
examples.english: His thoughtless remarks caused a problem.

examples.japanese: {軽率|けいそつ}な{行動|こうどう}は{避|さ}けるべきだ。
{軽率|けいそつ}に{約束|やくそく}してしまった。

notes:
FORMS:
・{軽率|けいそつ}な + noun (adnominal)
・{軽率|けいそつ}に (adverbial)
・{軽率|けいそつ}だ (predicative)

FORMATION:
{軽|けい} (light) + {率|そつ} (rate, lead) - originally meaning "leading lightly" without due caution

USAGE:
Negative connotation. Used to criticize careless behavior:
・{軽率|けいそつ}な{判断|はんだん} (hasty judgment)
・{軽率|けいそつ}な{態度|たいど} (thoughtless attitude)
・{軽率|けいそつ}な{対応|たいおう} (careless response)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{浅|あさ}はか - shallow, thoughtless
・{無謀|むぼう} - reckless, rash
・{短絡的|たんらくてき} - simplistic, short-sighted
